verses.en: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.sm: Levi; o Keresona, o Koato, ma Merari.

verses.en: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Koato; o Amaramo, o Isara, ma Heperona, ma Usialu.

verses.en: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.sm: O fanau a Amaramo; o Arona, ma Mose, ma Miriama. O atalii o Arona; o Natapu, ma Aviu, o Eleasaro, ma Itamaro.

verses.en: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
verses.sm: Ua fanaua e Eleasaro o Fineaso. ua fanaua e Fineaso o Apisua,

verses.en: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
verses.sm: ua fanaua E Apisua o Puki, ua fanaua e Puki o Usi,

verses.en: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
verses.sm: ua fanaua e Usi o Serakia, ua fanaua e Serakia o Meraiota,

verses.en: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.sm: ua fanaua e Meraiota o Amaria, ua fanaua e Amaria o Akitopo,

verses.en: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
verses.sm: ua fanaua e Akitopo o Satoka, ua fanaua e Satoka o Aimaasu,

verses.en: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
verses.sm: ua fanaua e Aimaasu o Asaria, ua fanaua e Asaria o Iokana,

verses.en: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
verses.sm: ua fanaua e Iokana o Asaria, o ia na faitaulaga i le fale na faia e Solomona i Ierusalema;

verses.en: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.sm: ua fanaua e Asaria o Amaria, ua fanaua e Amaria o Akitopo,

verses.en: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
verses.sm: ua fanaua e Akitopo o Satoka, ua fanaua e Satoka o Saluma,

verses.en: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
verses.sm: ua fanaua e Saluma o Hilikia, ua fanaua e Hilikia o Asaria,

verses.en: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
verses.sm: ua fanaua e Asaria o Seraia, ua fanaua e Seraia o losatako,

verses.en: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.sm: a ua alu atu Tosatako ina ua faataàfeaina e le ALII o Iuta ma Ierusalema i le lima o Nepukanesa.

verses.en: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.sm: O atalii o Levi; o Keresona, o Koato, ma Merari.

verses.en: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.sm: O igoa nei o atalii o Keresona; o Lepeni ma Semi.

verses.en: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.sm: O atalii o Koato; o Amaramo, ma Isara, ma Hepetona, ma Usialu.

verses.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
verses.sm: O araw o Merari; o Maali, ma Muse. O aiga ia o sa Levi e faatatau i o latou tama.

verses.en: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.sm: Na ia Keresona; o Lepeni lona atalii, o Iakata lona atalii, o Sema lona atalii,

verses.en: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
verses.sm: o Ioaa lona atalii, o Itu lona atalii, o Sera lona atalii, o Iatirai lona atalii.

verses.en: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Koato; o Aminatapu lona atalii, o Koru lona atalii, o Asiro lona atalii,

verses.en: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
verses.sm: o Elekana lona atalii, ma Aviasafo lona atalii, ma Asiro lona atalii,

verses.en: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.sm: o Taata lona atalii, o Urielu lona atalii, o Usia lona atalii, ma Saulo lona atalii.

verses.en: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Elekana; o Amesai, ma Akimota.

verses.en: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
verses.sm: O Elekana; o le fanauga a Elekana; o Sofai lona atalii, ma Makao lona atalii,

verses.en: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.sm: o Eliapo lona atalii, o Ieroama lona atalii, o Elekana lona atalii.

verses.en: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
verses.sm: O atalii nei o Samuelu; o Vaseni le ulumatua, ma Avia.

verses.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Merari; o Maali lona atalii, o Lepeni lona atalii, o Semi lona atalii, o Usa lona atalii,

verses.en: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.sm: 0 Samea lona atalii, o Hakia lona atalii, o Asaia lona atalii.

verses.en: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.
verses.sm: O i latou nei sa tofia e Tavita e fai pesega i le fale o le Aw, ina ua tumau at le atolaau.

verses.en: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.
verses.sm: Na latou auauna foi i pese i luma o le malumalu o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga, ina seia faia le fale o le ALII e Solomona i Ierusalema, ona latou tutú ai lea i lo latou faiva e tusa ma o latou tofiga.

verses.en: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
verses.sm: O i latou nei na tutū i latou atoa ma o latou atalii. O isi o le fanauga a sa Koatò; o Hemana o le usu pese ia, o le atalii o Ioelu, o le araw ia o Samuelu,

verses.en: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.sm: o le atalii ia o Elekana, o le atalii ia o Ieroama, o le atalii ia o Elielu, o le atalii ia o Toka,

verses.en: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.sm: o le atalii ia o Sufi, o le araw ia o Elekana, o le atalii ia o Makata, o le atalii ia o Amesai,

verses.en: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.sm: o le atalii ia o Elekana, o le atalii ia o Ioelu, o le atalii ia o Asaria, o le atalii ia o Sefania,

verses.en: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.sm: o le atalii ia o Taata, o le atalii ia o Asiro, o le atalii ia o Aviasafo, o le atalii ia o Koru,

verses.en: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.sm: o le atalii ia o Isara, o le atalii ia o Koato, o le atalii ia o Levi, o le atalii ia o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.sm: O lona uso foi o Asafo, o le na tu i lona itu taumatau, o Asafo, o le atalii ia o Perekia, o le atalii ia o Samea,

verses.en: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
verses.sm: o le atalii ia o Mekaeli, o le atalii ia o Paaseia, o le atalii ja o Malakia,

verses.en: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.sm: o le atalii ia o Etini, o le atalii ja o Sera, o le atalii ia o Ataia,

verses.en: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.sm: o le atalii ia o Etano, o le atalii ia o Sema, o le atalii ia o Semi,

verses.en: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.sm: o le atalii o Takata, o le atalii o Keresona. o le araw o Levi.

verses.en: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.sm: O latou uso foi o le fanauga a Merari na tutu i latou i le itu tauagavale; o Etano le atalii o Kisi, o le atalii ia o Opeti, o le atalii ia o Maluka,

verses.en: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.sm: o le atalii ia o Hasapea, o le atalii ia o Amasia, o le araw ia o Hilikia,

verses.en: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
verses.sm: o le araw ia o Amesi, o le atalii ia o Pani, o le atalii ia o Semeri,

verses.en: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.sm: o le atalii ia o Maali, o le atalii ia o Musi, o le atalii ia o Merari, o le atalii ja o Levi.

verses.en: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.sm: O latou uso foi o sa Levi na tofia i latou i galuega uma lava o Je malumalu o le fale o le Atua.

verses.en: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.sm: A o Arona ma ona atalii na latou fai taulaga i luga o le fata faitaulaga i taulaga mu, ma luga o le fata e mu ai mea manogi, ua tofia i galuega uma i le mea e sili ona paia, e fai ai foi le togiola mo Isaraelu, e tusa ma mea uma na poloai mai ai Mose le auauna a le Atua.

verses.en: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.sm: O le fanauga lenei a Arona; o Eleasaro lona atalii, o Fineaso lona atalii, o Apisua lona atalii,

verses.en: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.sm: şr o Puki lona atali, o Usi lona atalii, o Serakia lona atalii,

verses.en: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.sm: o Meraiota lona atalii, o Amaria lona atalii, o Akitopo lona atalii,

verses.en: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.sm: o Satoka lona atalii, o Aimaasu lona atalii.

verses.en: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for their's was the lot.
verses.sm: O mea nei sa nonofo ai i latou, o atalii o Arona, o aiga o sa Koato i o latou ‘olo i o latou nuuj; aua ua ia te i latou le tofi.

verses.en: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.sm: Na latou tuuina atu ia te i latou o Heperona i le nuu o Iuta ma ona tuáfanua e siosio ai.

verses.en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.sm: A o fanua o le aai ma ona faoa aai, na tuuina atu e i latou ia Kalepo le atalii o Iefune.

verses.en: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
verses.sm: Na latou tuuina atu i atalii o Arona o aai O sulufaiga, o Heperona; o Lipena foi ma ona tuāfanua, ma latira, ma Esetemoa ma ona tuàfanua,

verses.en: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
verses.sm: o Holona foi ma ona tuafanua, o Tiperi ma ona tuáfanua,

verses.en: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs:
verses.sm: O Asana ma ona tuafanua, ma Petesemesa ma ona tuafanua,

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
verses.sm: O aai o le itu aiga o Peniamina; o Kipea ma ona tuafanua, ma Alemeta ma ona tuāfanua, ma Ana595 tota ma ona tuāfanua. O latou aai uma i o latou aiga, o aai e sefulu ma le tolu.

verses.en: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Koato, o e na totoe o le aiga o lena itu aiga, na tuuina atu i ai i le vili o aai e sefulu, ai le vaega o le itu aiga, o le tasi vaega lea o Manase.

verses.en: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.sm: Na avatu foi i atalii o Keresona i o latou aiga, o aai e sefulu ma le tolu, mai le itu aiga o Isakara, ma le itu aiga o Asera, ma le itu aiga o Nafatali, ma le itu aiga o Manase i Vasana.

verses.en: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.sm: Na avatu i atalii o Merari i o latou aiga, i le vili, o aai e sefulu ma le lua, mai le itu aiga o Reupena, ma le itu aiga o Kato, ma le itu aiga o Sepulona.

verses.en: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.
verses.sm: Na avatua e le fanauga a Isaraelu i sa Levi o ia aai ma o latou tuāfanua.

verses.en: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
verses.sm: Na tuuina atu E i latou i le vili o aai nei, ua taʻua ai o latou igoa, ai le itu aiga o le fanauga a Iuta, ma le itu aiga o le fanauga a Simeona, ma le itu aiga o le fanauga a Peniamina.

verses.en: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.sm: O isi aiga foi o atalii o Koato ua i ai aai i o latou nuu mai le itu aiga o Efaraima.

verses.en: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Na latou tuuina atu ia te i latou aai o sulufaiga, o Sekema ma ona tuāfanua i le mauga o Efaraima; o Kasera foi ma ona tuāfanua,

verses.en: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs,
verses.sm: ma Iokameama ma ona tuāfanua, ma Peteorana ma ona tuāfanua,

verses.en: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs:
verses.sm: o Ailona foi ma ona tuāfanua, ma Katarimoni ma ona tuāfanua.

verses.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
verses.sm: Na avatua foi nai le tasi vaega o le itu aiga o Manase, o Aneri ma ona tuāfanua, ma Pileama ma ona tuāfanua, mo E o ‘totoe o le aiga o atalii o Koato.

verses.en: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
verses.sm: Na avatua i atalii o Keresona, mai le aiga o le tasi vaega o le itu aiga o Manase, o Koleni i Vasana ma ona tuāfanua, ma Aserota ma ona tuāfanua;

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
verses.sm: na avatua mai le itu giga o Isakara, o Katesa ma ona tuāfanua, o Taperu ma ona tuāfanua,

verses.en: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
verses.sm: o Ramota foi ma ona tuāfanua, ma Anima ma ona tuāfanua.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Na avatua nai le itu aiga o Asera, o Mesala ma ona tuāfanua, ma Apetono ma ona tuāfanua,

verses.en: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
verses.sm: ma Hukoka mə ona tuāfanua, ma Reopa ma ona tuāfanua.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
verses.sm: Na avatua nai le itu aiga o Nafatali, o Katesa i Kalilaia ma ona tuāfanua, ma Hamoni ma ona tuāfanua, ma Kiriatima ma ona tuāfanua.

verses.en: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
verses.sm: O e na totoe o atalii o Merari na avatu i ai mai le itu aiga o Sepulona o Rimoni ma ona tuāfanua, ma Tapora ma ona tuāfanua.

verses.en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Na avatua ia te i latou i lela itu o Ioritana e fesagai ma Ieriko, i le itu i sasae o Ioritana, mai le itu aiga o Reupena, o Peseri i le vao ma ona tuāfanua, ma laesa ma ona tuāfanua,

verses.en: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
verses.sm: O Katemoti foi ma ona tuāfanua, ma Mefata ma ona tuāfanua.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.sm: Na avatua nai le itu aiga o Kato o Ramota i Kiliata ma ona tuāfanua, ma Maanaima ma ona tuāfanua,

verses.en: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
verses.sm: o Hesepona foi ma ona tuāfanua ma lasaru ma ona tuāfanua.
